title: Phase 1 Operation FAQ And Troubleshooting
description: Machine-testable troubleshooting catalogue for Phase 1 local mock delivery. It documents safe recovery steps without connecting to real providers or executing unknown input scripts.

faqItems.title: CLI reports VALIDATION_ERROR because an input file is missing
faqItems.symptom: A command such as phase1 check or lab generate-from-source returns success=false with code=VALIDATION_ERROR and field=input.
faqItems.likelyCause: The input path does not exist or the command was run from outside the project root.
faqItems.safeResolution: Run commands from the project root and use the tracked demo file examples/input/demo-source.md, or create a local Phase 1 input file before invoking the command.
blockedActions: Do not fetch remote material automatically
Do not execute unknown input scripts

faqItems.title: DSL schema validation fails
faqItems.symptom: dsl validate or phase1 check fails with schema-related errors.
faqItems.likelyCause: A Lab, Exam, Grading, or PPT DSL example is missing required fields, uses an unsupported enum, or no longer matches its JSON Schema.
faqItems.safeResolution: Compare the YAML with the matching schema under templates/*/*.schema.json and keep generated content in WAITING_REVIEW until validation passes.
blockedActions: Do not bypass schema validation
Do not publish invalid DSL

faqItems.title: Reject fails because reason is missing
faqItems.symptom: review reject returns a validation or state error when --reason is omitted.
faqItems.likelyCause: Phase 1 audit policy requires every reject action to include a reviewer and a reason.
faqItems.safeResolution: Run review reject with --reviewer and --reason so the audit trail explains why the generated DSL was rejected.
blockedActions: Do not reject without an audit reason
Do not edit the local store to skip review

faqItems.title: Publish is blocked before approval
faqItems.symptom: review publish returns STATE_TRANSITION_ERROR for a task still in WAITING_REVIEW.
faqItems.likelyCause: Generated Lab, Exam, Grading, and PPT outputs must be approved by a human before mock publish can move the task to COMPLETED.
faqItems.safeResolution: Inspect the task with review detail, then approve or reject it. Publish remains a MOCK_ONLY state change after approval.
blockedActions: Do not bypass WAITING_REVIEW
Do not trigger real publish

faqItems.title: phase1 report cannot find the delivery package
faqItems.symptom: phase1 report returns success=false with field=package.
faqItems.likelyCause: The generated examples/output/phase1-delivery-package.json file was cleaned or not exported yet.
faqItems.safeResolution: Run phase1 export first, then run phase1 report against the generated local package.
blockedActions: Do not upload the package to a remote service
Do not recreate the package with non-allowlisted scripts

faqItems.title: phase1 report rejects a non-MOCK_ONLY package
faqItems.symptom: phase1 report returns VALIDATION_ERROR for package.mode.
faqItems.likelyCause: The package was edited manually or came from a non-Phase-1 source.
faqItems.safeResolution: Regenerate the package with python lab_cli.py phase1 export and confirm mode=MOCK_ONLY before rendering the report.
blockedActions: Do not accept REAL mode packages in Phase 1
Do not call real providers to rebuild the report

faqItems.title: Need a single static entry point for operator handoff
faqItems.symptom: An operator is unsure whether to open the console, delivery preview, runbook, or acceptance pages first.
faqItems.likelyCause: The Phase 1 package contains multiple static preview pages and documentation artifacts.
faqItems.safeResolution: Open frontend/operations-launchpad.html first. It links to the mock console, demo map, runbook, acceptance page, delivery page, audit, and review center without contacting real services.
blockedActions: Do not start a backend service just to preview Phase 1 handoff
Do not upload static previews to a remote service

faqItems.title: Operator is unsure how to present the Phase 1 demo
faqItems.symptom: The demo has multiple static pages, CLI commands, and handoff documents, but the presenter needs one speaking order.
faqItems.likelyCause: Launchpad, Demo Map, Runbook, Acceptance, Delivery, Audit, FAQ, and Handoff each serve a different part of the local mock handoff.
faqItems.safeResolution: Follow delivery/DEMO_SCRIPT_CHECKLIST.md from Launchpad to Demo Map, Runbook, phase1 check/export/report, Acceptance, Delivery, Audit Incidents, review gate, and final safety boundary.
blockedActions: Do not improvise by running non-allowlisted commands
Do not turn manual preview steps into an automated script

faqItems.title: Real provider health checks are disabled
faqItems.symptom: Provider settings show MockProvider active and real providers disabled.
faqItems.likelyCause: Phase 1 intentionally disables real OpenAI, Claude, local model, network access, and secret reads.
faqItems.safeResolution: Use provider list, provider health, or provider mock-generate only for MockProvider validation. Keep API keys in environment examples only.
blockedActions: Do not enable real providers
Do not read or print secrets
Do not access the network

faqItems.title: Shell material is flagged but not executed
faqItems.symptom: material analyze marks shell-related risk and requires human review.
faqItems.likelyCause: Phase 1 performs static analysis only and treats shell scripts as review risks.
faqItems.safeResolution: Review the risk summary manually. Do not run the script on the host machine; later phases must route execution through a sandbox design.
blockedActions: Do not execute unknown Shell scripts
Do not run contestant code on the host

faqItems.title: Running python cli/lab_cli.py causes import issues
faqItems.symptom: The CLI fails to import project modules when launched from cli/lab_cli.py directly.
faqItems.likelyCause: The supported project-root entrypoint is lab_cli.py, which imports cli.lab_cli with the expected module path.
faqItems.safeResolution: Run python lab_cli.py ... from the project root for all documented commands.
blockedActions: Do not create duplicate entrypoints
Do not change public CLI command groups casually

faqItems.title: Generated outputs disappear after cleanup
faqItems.symptom: examples/output/phase1-delivery-package.json or phase1-acceptance-report.md is missing after validation cleanup.
faqItems.likelyCause: Generated reports and delivery packages are intentionally local, reproducible, and ignored by source tracking.
faqItems.safeResolution: Regenerate them with the allowlisted phase1 export and phase1 report commands whenever needed.
blockedActions: Do not commit generated packages
Do not archive local outputs as source of truth

faqItems.title: pytest or schema dependencies are missing
faqItems.symptom: python -m pytest fails before running tests because a dependency cannot be imported.
faqItems.likelyCause: The local Python environment has not installed requirements.txt.
faqItems.safeResolution: Install the declared local development dependencies with python -m pip install -r requirements.txt, then rerun the targeted test command.
blockedActions: Do not skip tests after dependency setup fails
Do not vendor secrets or production configuration into tests
